title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
statement: Given a list of daily stock prices, choose one day to buy and a later day to sell to maximize profit. Return 0 if no profit is possible.
constraints: sell day must be later than buy day
solution_code:
def max_profit(prices):
    min_price = float('inf')
    best_profit = 0
    for price in prices:
        min_price = min(min_price, price)
        best_profit = max(best_profit, price - min_price)
    return best_profit

editor_note.idea: Track the smallest price seen so far and compare each later price against it.
editor_note.data_structure_reason: Two rolling variables are enough, so there is no need for an array of states.
editor_note.edge_cases: If prices always decrease, the result stays 0.
editor_note.pitfalls: The min price must come from an earlier day.
